shortDescription: Import TLS certificate and key onto F5OS devices.

options.name: certificate
options.description: The PEM-formatted certificate string or path to a certificate file. Sensitive value, will not be shown in logs or output.

options.name: key
options.description: The PEM-formatted private key string or path to a key file. Sensitive value, will not be shown in logs or output.

options.name: key_passphrase
options.description: The passphrase for the private key, if it is encrypted. Sensitive value, will not be shown in logs or output.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the cert/key should be present or absent on the device.

options.name: verify_client
options.description: Whether to enable client certificate verification.

options.name: verify_client_depth
options.description: The maximum depth for client certificate verification.
